description: Use this when someone asks how Georgia natural gas rates have changed over time, whether gas prices in Georgia are going up or down, what gas cost last winter or in a past year, or how one marketer's price has moved. Returns month-by-month cheapest and median estimated annual cost for one plan type (fixed = standard 12-month) across the PSC filings Open Natural Gas has published since January 2019, optionally for one marketer. Months that were withheld by the data gate are listed, not skipped silently. Do not use for this month's prices or ranking (use compare_rates), forecasts of future rates, electricity, Liberty Utilities or city/municipal gas systems (use lookup_georgia_gas_provider), other states, or wholesale/Henry Hub prices.

from.description: First month, YYYY-MM (for example 2025-01); omit to start at the earliest published month, 2019-01

marketer.description: Limit to one marketer, by name as it appears in compare_rates results (partial names match); omit for the whole market

plan_type.description: fixed = standard 12-month fixed (default), variable, senior, or prepay

to.description: Last month, YYYY-MM (for example 2026-10); omit to end at the latest published month

name: rate_history
title: Georgia gas rate history
